why: The two statements differ in a hypothesis and in content. A (theorem_19_7_29_hyp) assumes Bh.IsCompatible, which B does not (it is not automatic: the project's not_isCompatible_twistBasic). Even under IsCompatible, A asserts only Nonempty (ProperPolyfoldCoveringFunctor gctA gctB). It does not say that the functor is P or that its polyfold structure of B is the one of (F, 𝓕), which is B's content, so A does not give B. Under IsCompatible, B's conclusion does hold through the project's definition toProperPolyfoldCoveringFunctor, but that is not a consequence of A. In the other direction, B gives A's Nonempty conjunct (B_to_nonempty, proved, rt_check OK). It does not give the rest of A: HasCoveringUniformizers of the polyfold construction of B, the open embeddings |Ψ̂| with T_{|A|} and their covering of |A|, the sheet-model identities of each Ψ̂, and the fibred-product description of M(Ψ̂,Ψ̂') through gammaFib.
